title: The bulk bar sits under the tabs and counts the ticked rows
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have two active parts, part A and part B.
  • Give parts A and B part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists both.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Type the shared start of the part numbers in the Search box.
  2. Click the three-dot actions button (⋮) in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  3. Click Deactivate parts.
  4. Click the part A row.
  5. Click the part B row.
  6. Click the part A row again.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Parts A and B are listed, and the search and filter row sits directly under the Active and Inactive tabs.

Step 2:

  • The menu opens.

Step 3:

  • A dark bar appears directly under the Active and Inactive tabs, across the full width of the list.
  • The search and filter row moves down and now sits under the bar.
  • From left to right the bar shows a round badge reading 0 followed by the word "selected", a thin divider, and a blue "Deactivate" button, with an X at the right end.
  • The New Inventory Part button is still shown.

Step 4:

  • The badge reads 1.

Step 5:

  • The badge reads 2, and the line under the table reads "2 records selected."

Step 6:

  • The badge reads 1.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10815 (Story 2, Deactivate Parts in Bulk)

  • S2-R7: “While the mode is on, the bulk bar spans the full width of the list directly under the Active and Inactive tabs, and the search and filter row moves down under it.”
  • S2-R7b: “From left to right the bar shows: the number of ticked rows in a round badge followed by the word "selected", a thin divider, and a blue button reading "Deactivate". The number updates as the user ticks.”
  • S2-R9: “An X button sits at the right end of the bar. Hovering it shows "Clear selection", which is also its screen reader label.”
  • Terminology: “Bulk bar → The dark bar across the Inventory list, under the Active and Inactive tabs, while bulk status mode is on. It is the same bar work order lines show for ticked lines.”

From: Tech plan "Parts Lifecycle Update — Technical Implementation Plan" (7 Oct 2026, written against PRD v22; re-shared by the QA lead on 27 Oct 2026, unchanged), read 27 Oct 2026

  • §3 Technical Decisions, D24: “design boards settle what the PRD is silent on. Show "N records selected." under the table in bulk mode (boards 4.3, 4.9). Keep "New Inventory Part" visible in bulk mode (4.3, 4.8).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
